reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Kroger
reauth_confirm.description: Kroger refresh tokens expire after six months. Select **Submit** to sign in again.

store.title: Choose your store
store.description: Your ZIP code is used once, to list nearby stores. The chain filter narrows the list to one banner.

data_description.chain: For example KINGSOOPERS, KROGER, FRED MEYER or RALPHS.

data_description.modality: Whether items are added for pickup or delivery by default.

manual_store.title: Enter your store ID
manual_store.description: No stores came back for that ZIP code and chain. You can enter the eight-character store ID by hand instead.

error.no_locations: No stores were found for that ZIP code and chain.

abort.already_in_progress: Kroger setup is already in progress.
abort.oauth2_missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.oauth2_no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url})

data_description.location_id: The eight-character store ID used to price and stock-check searches.

application_credentials.description: Create an application in the [Kroger developer console]({developer_console_url}) with the redirect URI `{redirect_url}` and the scopes `cart.basic:write`, `product.compact` and `profile.compact`, then paste its client ID and secret here.

add_to_cart.name: Add to cart
add_to_cart.description: Adds an item to the cart of the signed-in Kroger account, identified either by name or by UPC, or the first of its alternatives that can be had. The item lands in the cart for whichever store that account currently has selected. Returns what was added and whether it was a substitute.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Kroger account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

upc.name: UPC
upc.description: One 13-digit product ID, or a list of them, instead of a name. Use the Search products action to find them. Give either this or a name.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of each item to add.

modality.name: Modality
modality.description: Pickup or delivery. Defaults to the value chosen during setup.

term.name: Product name
term.description: The product's name, as shown on the store's website. An exact name always wins; if the name matches several products the action fails and lists them rather than guessing, because Kroger's search is fuzzy and its result order is not stable.

brand.name: Brand
brand.description: Narrows a name search to one brand. Case-sensitive.

check_availability.name: Check availability
check_availability.description: Look the product up before adding and refuse if the store cannot supply it for the chosen modality. Leave this on: the cart endpoint answers 204 for an unorderable item just as it does for a real one, and the API cannot remove what it added.

size.name: Size
size.description: Narrows a name search by package size, for example '32 fl oz'. Often required: Kroger sells different products under descriptions that differ only in capitalisation, and size is what tells them apart.

alternatives.name: Alternatives
alternatives.description: Fallback items, in order of preference, for when the item cannot be had. Each is a UPC, a product name, or a mapping with 'term' or 'upc' plus optional 'size' and 'brand'. An item is passed over only when Kroger reports it unavailable or cannot find it; an ambiguous name still fails. Needs Check availability, and a single item rather than a list of UPCs.

search_products.name: Search products
search_products.description: Searches the Kroger catalogue and returns matching products with their UPCs, prices, stock levels and whether your store can supply them.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Kroger account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

term.name: Search term
term.description: A fuzzy search term, at least three characters and at most eight words.

brand.name: Brand
brand.description: Restrict results to one brand. Case-sensitive.

location_id.name: Store ID
location_id.description: Overrides the configured store. Prices, stock levels and aisles are relative to this store.

fulfillment.name: Fulfillment
fulfillment.description: Restrict results to products available these ways.

product_id.name: UPC
product_id.description: Look up one exact 13-digit product ID instead of searching.

alternatives_need_check.message: Alternatives need Check availability turned on; without the lookup nothing is ever found unavailable, so no alternative could be reached.

alternatives_need_one_item.message: Alternatives can back up a single item only, not a list of UPCs.

auth_failed.message: Kroger rejected the credentials. The refresh token may have expired; reauthenticate the integration.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Kroger API.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Kroger account with ID {entry_id}.

multiple_entries.message: More than one Kroger account is set up. Specify which one with the Account field.

name_ambiguous.message: '{term}' matches {count} available products, so nothing was added. Use a more specific name or a UPC. Candidates: {candidates}

name_none_available.message: Nothing matching '{term}' can be supplied for {modality} by your store right now. Closest matches: {candidates}

need_upc_or_term.message: Give either a product name or a UPC, not both and not neither.

no_alternative_available.message: Neither the item nor any of its alternatives can be had right now, so nothing was added. Tried: {tried}

no_entries.message: No Kroger account is set up and loaded.

not_available.message: {description} (UPC {upc}) cannot be supplied for {modality} by your store right now, so it was not added.

rate_limited.message: Kroger's daily call limit has been reached. The cart allowance is 5,000 calls per day and the product allowance is 10,000.

search_needs_term.message: A search needs either a search term or a brand.

upc_not_found.message: Kroger has no product with UPC {upc} at your store.
